title: SWF compile: DefineBitsLossless2 (tag 36) palette mode (BitmapFormat=3) not implemented
description: packages/swf/src/bitmaps.ts only implements BitmapFormat=5 (32-bit ARGB) for DefineBitsLossless2. BitmapFormat=3 (8-bit indexed with 256-color palette) is never emitted. Real Flash content occasionally uses palette-mode bitmaps — when a DefineBitsLossless2 with format 3 is needed, the compiler silently falls back to 32-bit which wastes space. Fix: detect when bitmap source data is paletted (e.g. PNG with palette), build a 256-entry RGBA palette + indexed pixel data, and emit BitmapFormat=3 tag body per SWF spec §2.4.2.2 (UI8 colorTableSize, then palette as RGBA entries, then pixel data zlib-compressed).
